title: Countdown Halting and Output Bound
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, every valid input-head position $p$ on $x$, and every natural number $n$, if a counter word $u$ has little-endian value $n$, then for every initial output word there is a time $t\le (n+1)(2|u|+3)$ at which the countdown emitter, started in its borrow phase with work head at position zero and counter $u$, has halted and its output is the initial word followed by exactly $n$ ones.
replaced: For every input, head position and counter word $u$ of value $n$, and every already-emitted word: within $(n+1)(2|u|+3)$ steps from the borrow state at cell zero, the countdown emitter halts with output equal to the already-emitted word followed by exactly $n$ ones.
